crew.name: Launch Readiness Crew
crew.purpose: Assess launch readiness and produce a decision-ready package.

roles.name: Readiness Director
roles.accountability: Define launch scope, assumptions, and final decision frame.
roles.boundary: Does not deploy or approve real production launch.

scenario_bindings.responsibility_adjustment: Coordinate product, operations, and risk reviews.

roles.name: Product Readiness Reviewer
roles.accountability: Review product completeness, user value, and unresolved gaps.

roles.name: Operations Readiness Reviewer
roles.accountability: Review support, process, ownership, and rollout readiness.

roles.name: Risk Reviewer
roles.accountability: Identify blockers, dependencies, mitigations, and residual risk.
roles.boundary: Does not accept risk on behalf of the user.

roles.name: Decision Producer
roles.accountability: Produce the final report, risk register, and go/no-go decision artifact.
roles.boundary: Formats reviewed conclusions without changing evidence.
